questions.q: Where do you start if the drone won't arm in Betaflight?
options: The status command in the CLI
questions.explain: status shows the Arming disable flags — the firmware names the reason itself.

options: The OSD menu is open during arming
questions.explain: Check the port, protocol and inversion, the bind and 5 V on the receiver.

questions.q: One motor doesn't spin. The first cheap step?
options: Reflash the ESC and calibrate the throttle
questions.explain: Swap with a working motor: if the problem moved with the wire — signal/FC pad; if it stayed — ESC/motor.

questions.q: The smoke stopper bulb glows brightly, the aircraft doesn't power up:
options: The battery is discharged below the BEC threshold
questions.explain: Disconnect the loads one at a time: where the bulb goes out — that's where the short is.

questions.q: It shakes above 70% throttle. The first action?
options: Lower P on all axes by 20 %
Record a Blackbox log and the spectrum
questions.explain: Without a log it's guesswork; the spectrum distinguishes mechanics, filtering and resonance.

questions.q: The sign of ESC desync in the log:
options: An LQ drop at the moment of a throttle punch
An eRPM dip on one motor
questions.explain: A sudden eRPM dip on one motor with a jerk: ESC settings, DShot, phases.

questions.q: The “one change — one check” rule is needed in order to:
options: Avoid touching the CLI between flights
questions.explain: Two changes at once — the cause is not established.

questions.q: The ANGLE flag when arming in Betaflight means:
options: The aircraft is tilted more than small_angle
questions.explain: ANGLE — tilted more than small_angle: put it level or calibrate the accelerometer.
